name: Hidden Spring Cleaners
brandNarrative: Hidden Spring Cleaners is a family-owned dry cleaner at the West Linn Retail Center. Recent Google reviews mention consistent quality, careful handling of delicate fabric, professional pressing, successful stain removal, and mending on a beaded silk blouse.

services.name: Dry Cleaning
services.description: Careful dry cleaning for garments that need professional fabric handling.

services.name: Stain Care
services.description: Customer reviews describe tough stains being removed without harming the fabric.

services.name: Mending
services.description: Public reviews mention mending requests completed alongside garment care.

services.name: Pressing
services.description: Recent customers note clothes returned fresh, clean, and professionally ironed.

reviews.text: Excellent dry cleaning service with consistent quality and care. My clothes always come back fresh, clean, and perfectly ironed. Even tough stains are removed without harming the fabric.
reviews.author: Joan Swanson

reviews.text: I brought in a valuable beaded silk blouse with decorative stitching and another blouse that needed mending. The charge was $31. I paid a small tip because the job was so well done on a difficult task.
reviews.author: Jennifer Phillips

reviews.text: Family owned small business, I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

faq.question: Where is Hidden Spring Cleaners located?
faq.answer: Hidden Spring Cleaners is at 19383 Willamette Dr in the West Linn Retail Center, West Linn, OR 97068.

faq.question: What can I bring in?
faq.answer: Bring in the garments you would like us to dry clean, press, spot-treat, or mend. Let us know about stains, fabric concerns, or repairs when you drop them off.

faq.question: When is the business open?
faq.answer: Monday through Friday 9:00 AM–6:30 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, and closed Sunday.
